resolutions.finding: Claude M1: explain retention choice and its unmeasured performance cost.
resolutions.resolution: Retained interval 128 under the explicit goal allowance for focused serving-setting changes. Kept required decode-created reuse and disclosed that zero or intervals beyond the fixed probe can only produce diagnostics. Hero keeps periodic Mamba states; Snowball keeps dense SWA blocks at this interval. Zero to 128 throughput effect is unmeasured on both models; no Hero AgentX window exists.

No new permission or GPU comparison is needed to finish this goal. A general conditional-coverage API or retention search can be considered separately.

resolutions.finding: Claude M2: assess the cache-pressure hypothesis using C64 telemetry.
resolutions.resolution: Retained ten live sample pairs. C64 lowers KV use but leaves a large gap between actual and theoretical prefix reuse. Cache capacity is an incomplete explanation. Routing across eight DP engines without the optional router is an untested lead. Added two skill sentences to compare hit rates, KV use and routing; no experiment was added.
